fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the safety and construction problems of Dade County’s new courthouse building (reported sinking and remedial bracing), calls for a Miami harbor patrol to address theft and oily bilge dumping, and criticism of apartment owners’ “on application” rate practices amid expected winter tourism. Additional pieces address transportation conditions on Flagler Street streetcars, city licensing of seasonal “auction sales,” police court notes, and sports coverage including discussion of a possible Jack Dempsey fight in Miami and promotion by the Miami Sports Club. Social/entertainment columns and local advertisements appear throughout.
